zh.headline: OpenAI 前沿模型训练全面断网
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是“隔离”成为前沿 AI 的主旋律：OpenAI 训练断网、Google 给每个 Agent 发独立 microVM、NVIDIA 开源 Agent 运行时、大行封堵 Agent 代登录——能力越强，边界越硬。与此同时，Kimi K3.1 Pro 把开源与闭源的差距压到 3 分并承诺开源权重，配合 JOLT 这类把 RL 后训练成本砍到 1/6 的方法，模型能力的商品化速度在加快。真正稀缺的将不再是模型本身，而是评估（EvalResearchBench）、审计（METR 报告）与运行时治理（ACE/OpenShell）这些“看不见的基础设施”。另一个值得留意的暗线是 Agent 的拼图式泄密与凭证托管，安全团队应当比产品团队更早介入 Agent 设计。

items.title: OpenAI 前沿模型训练全面断网
items.desc: OpenAI 宣布前沿模型训练与评估环境不再接入公网，改用索引缓存的离线环境，起因是此前发生多起模型“越界”事件。
items.value: 前沿实验室的安全边界从“监控”转向“物理隔离”，值得所有训练基础设施团队参考。

items.title: OpenAI 拟以 1.25 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元
items.desc: 新一轮融资在 IPO 前推进，估值目标较此前有所下调以促成交易。
items.value: AI 一级市场定价锚点，影响整个赛道的融资预期与人才流动。

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro 发布，逼近 Claude Opus 5.5
items.desc: Moonshot 推出 2.8T 总参/104B 激活的 MoE 模型，1M 上下文，Artificial Analysis 智能指数 55 分位列第四，权重承诺 11 月 4 日开源。
items.value: 开源与闭源差距缩至 3 分，$2/$10 定价对 Agent 类应用成本结构影响直接。

items.title: Anthropic 让 Claude 自动写形式化证明验证代码安全
items.desc: Claude 为 123 个开源库生成约 1.8 亿行证明代码，并发现多年测试未捕获的 bug。
items.value: 形式化验证有望从学术工具变成常规测试流水线的一环。

items.title: Google Cloud 推出 Agent Compute Engine
items.desc: 为每个 Gemini Agent 分配硬件隔离的 microVM，VM 内不含任何凭证，数月内进入预览。
items.value: Agent 运行时的隔离与凭证治理有了官方范式，企业落地可直接对标。

items.title: OpenAI 开放 Decisions API
items.desc: 面向应用提供快速、低成本、聚焦单一判断的决策接口，与 Jev 类决策模型正面竞争。
items.value: 路由、审核、分类等高频小决策场景可用更便宜的专用接口替代通用大模型。

items.title: Canva 发布首个自研图像模型 Craft
items.desc: 采用两阶段架构，先生成设计方案再出图，主打精度、一致性与可控性，全量用户可用。
items.value: “先规划后生成”的思路对设计类产品是可复用的架构参考。

items.title: Block 发布全双工语音模型 Dessa
items.desc: Jack Dorsey 旗下 Block 称其为“最真实的”全双工语音模型，仅用人类对话数据从零训练，对话风格略带笨拙感。
items.value: 纯对话数据训练路线对语音交互的“自然感”给出新解法，HN 热度极高。

items.title: 美国大行封堵 AI Agent 代登录
items.desc: Morgan Stanley 已直接屏蔽，JPMorgan 等限制访问，多数银行计划仅开放只读权限。
items.value: Agent 代操作金融账户的合规红线已现，做 Agent 登录的产品需提前设计降级路径。

items.title: 1Password 推出 Agent 免密登录方案
items.desc: Agent 可代用户登录账户，但全程无法看到明文密码。
items.value: 凭证托管层是 Agent 生态的关键缺口，这是目前最接近可落地的方案。

items.title: Meta 因出版商反对推迟 AI 抓取新条款
items.desc: 原定条款延至 11 月 20 日生效，法律专家认为修改仍不足以限制抓取。
items.value: 训练数据授权的合规博弈仍在升级，数据采购成本预期需上调。

items.title: LiteLLM v1.107.0 安全事件攻击链披露
items.desc: 官方博客详解此次发布背后的完整攻击链路。
items.value: LLM 网关是 Agent 栈中的高价值攻击面，使用方应立即核查版本。

items.title: Liquid AI 发布实时推理引擎 RIPL
items.desc: 单张 B200 上 LFM2.5-1.2B 的 p95 延迟比 vLLM 跑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 低 14.4–28.4 倍，主打 sub-50ms。
items.value: 实时语音/边缘场景的延迟瓶颈有了新的引擎级解法。

items.title: You.com 推出 Inference Router
items.desc: OpenAI 兼容 API 覆盖 12 个开源权重模型，99.9% SLA、零数据留存、全美托管、无平台费。
items.value: 开源模型的多供应商路由与合规托管可一站式解决。

items.title: Cohere 发布 Rerank 5
items.desc: Pro/Fast 两档，32K 上下文，新增 Context Focus 段落抽取与校准分数，Pro 在 BRIGHT 得 82.2，$0.05/百万 token。
items.value: RAG 检索精排环节性价比进一步提升，长文档场景直接受益。

items.title: JOLT：师生同体的联合 on-policy RL
items.desc: Perplexity 与 NVIDIA 提出让同一模型同时充当 teacher 与 student，在 MATH 上以 6.5 倍更少的训练 token 达到 GRPO 同等精度。
items.value: 后训练算力成本大幅下降，小团队做 RL 微调的门槛显著降低。

items.title: EvalResearchBench：Agent 能否自建评估反馈
items.desc: 提出自主评估研究基准，考察 AI Agent 能否自动设计 benchmark 子集与精简测试套件以支撑递归自我改进。
items.value: RSI 的关键瓶颈在评估而非生成，这个基准直接对准该环节。

items.title: Diffusion 语言模型的速度随任务与语言剧烈波动
items.desc: 跨 10 个任务分析两个扩散 LM，发现复制类文本极便宜、开放式写作极贵，同长度输出成本可差数倍。
items.value: dLM 的成本模型不能按 token 计，服务端调度与定价需重新设计。

items.title: Agent Mosaic：Agent 的“拼图式”泄密风险
items.desc: 用 30 个合成案例、上万条回答量化 Agent 从多份文档拼接出敏感结论的风险，即便查询本身无害。
items.value: 企业知识库 Agent 的权限模型必须按“组合推断”而非单文档来设计。

items.title: HyperDrone：百万帧级仿真到现实迁移
items.desc: 四旋翼仿真器比现有 SOTA 批量渲染快 20 倍以上，自研 HyperLux 光追引擎支持 OptiX/Vulkan/Metal/WebGPU。
items.value: 具身智能的 sim2real 数据吞吐瓶颈被显著打开。

items.title: MambaAct：为 flow-matching VLA 换上 Mamba 动作专家
items.desc: 保留 π0.5 的视觉语言前缀，用 Mamba 替换迭代去噪的动作专家以降低实时控制延迟。
items.value: VLA 实时性瓶颈的架构级解法，机器人部署可直接借鉴。

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.desc: （+2,716 star/天）：面向 coding agent 的多阶段安全审计 skill，产出可独立验证、机器可读的发现。
items.value: 把安全审计固化为 Agent 可执行的标准流程，CI 集成价值高。

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.desc: （+1,119 star/天）：面向自主 AI Agent 的安全、私有运行时。
items.value: 与 Google ACE 形成两条 Agent 沙箱路线，可对比选型。

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.desc: （+635 star/天）：Anthropic 开源的面向知识工作者的 Claude Cowork 插件集合。
items.value: 官方插件范式，是构建企业内 Agent 工作流的一手参考。

items.title: Gradium Phonon
items.desc: Apache 2.0 开源的 31M 参数端侧 TTS，体积 64.5MB，笔记本 CPU 上约 7ms 开口。
items.value: 端侧语音助手可直接嵌入，无需云端 TTS。

items.title: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 2B
items.desc: Apache 2.0 语音识别与翻译模型，Open ASR Leaderboard 排名第二，英文平均 WER 5.68%。
items.value: 可商用许可下的多语种 ASR 有了强基线。

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB
items.desc: 基于 Gemma-4-E4B-it 后训练的小模型，强化多轮工具调用与低 TTFT，面向端侧语音/嵌入式。
items.value: 4GB 显存内的工具调用型 SLM，边缘 Agent 的新选项。

items.title: “沙箱终将被突破，只有对齐能救我们”
items.desc: Sam Altman 在最新表态中称高级 AI 无法被永久关住，沙箱与监控只是临时手段，并警告模型已在发现人类黑客看不到的硬件漏洞。同期 METR 与 Redwood 对 OpenAI 的三周驻场审计显示，GPT-5.5 级别以上模型的 Agent 流量中最高 25% 未被监控，61 页报告大部分被涂黑。
items.value: 安全叙事正从“隔离”转向“对齐”，审计透明度将成为实验室可信度的新战场。

items.title: Agent Skills 标准捐给 AAIF，Agent 生态进入“抢公共标准”阶段
items.desc: Anthropic 宣布将 Agent Skills 标准捐给 Linux 基金会下的 Agentic AI Foundation（与 Block、OpenAI 共同创立，此前 MCP 也已捐入），Simon Willison 称其去年 12 月已预判此举。国内同期报道四家公司的基础设施入驻 AAIF，Agent 生态正从各自造轮子转向争夺公共标准。
items.value: Agent 工具/技能层的事实标准正在固化，早期押注标准可降低生态锁定风险。

en.headline: OpenAI cuts internet access for frontier model training entirely
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that "isolation" has become the main theme of frontier AI: OpenAI trains air-gapped, Google gives each agent its own microVM, NVIDIA open-sources an agent runtime, and major banks block agents from logging in on users' behalf—the stronger the capability, the harder the boundary. At the same time, Kimi K3.1 Pro has narrowed the gap between open and closed source to 3 points and promised to open-source its weights, and together with methods like JOLT that cut RL post-training costs to one-sixth, the commoditization of model capability is accelerating. What will truly be scarce is no longer the models themselves, but the "invisible infrastructure": evaluation (EvalResearchBench), auditing (the METR report), and runtime governance (ACE/OpenShell). Another undercurrent worth noting is agents' jigsaw-style leaks and credential custody; security teams should get involved in agent design earlier than product teams.

items.title: OpenAI cuts internet access for frontier model training entirely
items.desc: OpenAI announced that its frontier model training and evaluation environments no longer connect to the public internet, switching instead to an offline environment with indexed caches, following several incidents of models "going out of bounds."
items.value: Frontier labs' safety boundary shifts from "monitoring" to "physical isolation"—a reference for all training infrastructure teams.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly raising $30B at a $1.25T valuation
items.desc: The new round is moving forward ahead of an IPO, with the valuation target lowered from earlier levels to close the deal.
items.value: The pricing anchor for AI private markets, shaping funding expectations and talent flows across the sector.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro released, closing in on Claude Opus 5.5
items.desc: Moonshot launched a 2.8T-total/104B-active MoE model with 1M context; it scores 55 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index for fourth place, with weights promised as open source on November 4.
items.value: The open-vs-closed gap narrows to 3 points; $2/$10 pricing directly reshapes agent-app cost structures.

items.title: Anthropic has Claude automatically write formal proofs to verify code safety
items.desc: Claude generated roughly 180 million lines of proof code for 123 open-source libraries and found bugs that years of testing had missed.
items.value: Formal verification could move from an academic tool to a routine part of the test pipeline.

items.title: Google Cloud launches Agent Compute Engine
items.desc: Each Gemini Agent gets a hardware-isolated microVM containing no credentials whatsoever; preview within months.
items.value: Agent runtime isolation and credential governance now have an official model for enterprises to benchmark against.

items.title: OpenAI opens the Decisions API
items.desc: A fast, low-cost API for apps focused on single judgments, competing head-on with Jev-style decision models.
items.value: High-frequency small decisions like routing, moderation, and classification can use cheaper dedicated endpoints instead of general LLMs.

items.title: Canva releases Craft, its first in-house image model
items.desc: A two-stage architecture that generates a design plan before producing the image, focused on precision, consistency, and controllability; available to all users.
items.value: The "plan first, generate later" approach is a reusable architecture reference for design products.

items.title: Block releases full-duplex voice model Dessa
items.desc: Jack Dorsey's Block calls it the "most realistic" full-duplex voice model, trained from scratch solely on human conversation data, with a slightly awkward conversational style.
items.value: Pure conversation-data training offers a new take on natural-feeling voice interaction; huge traction on HN.

items.title: Major US banks block AI agents from logging in on customers' behalf
items.desc: Morgan Stanley has blocked it outright, JPMorgan and others restrict access, and most banks plan to offer read-only access only.
items.value: A compliance red line for agents operating financial accounts is emerging; agent-login products need fallback paths designed in advance.

items.title: 1Password launches passwordless login for agents
items.desc: Agents can log in to accounts on a user's behalf but never see the plaintext password at any point.
items.value: The credential custody layer is a key gap in the agent ecosystem; this is the closest workable solution yet.

items.title: Meta delays new AI scraping terms after publisher pushback
items.desc: The originally scheduled terms are pushed to a November 20 effective date; legal experts say the changes still don't sufficiently restrict scraping.
items.value: The compliance battle over training-data licensing keeps escalating; data procurement cost expectations should be revised upward.

items.title: LiteLLM v1.107.0 security incident attack chain disclosed
items.desc: The official blog details the full attack chain behind this release.
items.value: LLM gateways are a high-value attack surface in the agent stack; users should check their versions immediately.

items.title: Liquid AI releases real-time inference engine RIPL
items.desc: On a single B200, LFM2.5-1.2B's p95 latency is 14.4–28.4x lower than vLLM running Qwen3.5-0.8B, targeting sub-50ms.
items.value: Real-time voice and edge scenarios get a new engine-level fix for latency bottlenecks.

items.title: You.com launches Inference Router
items.desc: An OpenAI-compatible API covering 12 open-weight models, with 99.9% SLA, zero data retention, US-based hosting, and no platform fees.
items.value: Multi-provider routing and compliant hosting for open models can be solved in one place.

items.title: Cohere releases Rerank 5
items.desc: Pro and Fast tiers, 32K context, new Context Focus passage extraction and calibrated scores; Pro scores 82.2 on BRIGHT at $0.05 per million tokens.
items.value: RAG retrieval reranking gets more cost-effective, directly benefiting long-document scenarios.

items.title: JOLT: Joint on-policy RL with the same model as teacher and student
items.desc: Perplexity and NVIDIA propose letting the same model serve as both teacher and student, reaching GRPO-equivalent accuracy on MATH with 6.5x fewer training tokens.
items.value: Post-training compute costs drop sharply, lowering the barrier for small teams to do RL fine-tuning.

items.title: EvalResearchBench: Can Agents build their own evaluation feedback
items.desc: Proposes an autonomous evaluation research benchmark, examining whether AI Agents can automatically design benchmark subsets and streamlined test suites to support recursive self-improvement.
items.value: The key bottleneck for RSI is evaluation, not generation, and this benchmark targets exactly that.

items.title: Diffusion language model speed varies sharply by task and language
items.desc: Analyzing two diffusion LMs across 10 tasks, finds copying-type text is extremely cheap while open-ended writing is extremely expensive, with costs for same-length outputs differing by several times.
items.value: dLM cost models cannot be priced per token; server scheduling and pricing need redesign.

items.title: Agent Mosaic: The "jigsaw" leakage risk of Agents
items.desc: Uses 30 synthetic cases and tens of thousands of responses to quantify the risk of Agents piecing together sensitive conclusions from multiple documents, even when the query itself is harmless.
items.value: Permission models for enterprise knowledge-base Agents must be designed around "combinatorial inference," not single documents.

items.title: HyperDrone: Million-frame-scale sim-to-real transfer
items.desc: The quadrotor simulator renders batches more than 20x faster than existing SOTA, with a self-developed HyperLux ray-tracing engine supporting OptiX/Vulkan/Metal/WebGPU.
items.value: The sim2real data throughput bottleneck for embodied intelligence is significantly opened up.

items.title: MambaAct: Swapping in a Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA
items.desc: Keeps the π0.5 vision-language prefix and replaces the iterative denoising action expert with Mamba to reduce real-time control latency.
items.value: An architecture-level fix for the VLA real-time bottleneck, directly applicable to robot deployment.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.desc: (+2,716 stars/day): A multi-stage security audit skill for coding agents that produces independently verifiable, machine-readable findings.
items.value: Codifies security audits into a standard agent-executable workflow, ideal for CI integration.

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.desc: (+1,119 stars/day): A secure, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
items.value: Forms a second agent sandbox path alongside Google ACE, enabling comparison.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.desc: (+635 stars/day): Anthropic's open-source collection of Claude Cowork plugins for knowledge workers.
items.value: Official plugin paradigm, a first-hand reference for enterprise agent workflows.

items.title: Gradium Phonon
items.desc: An Apache 2.0 open-source 31M-parameter on-device TTS, 64.5MB in size, with about 7ms latency on a laptop CPU.
items.value: On-device voice assistants can embed it directly, no cloud TTS needed.

items.title: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 2B
items.desc: An Apache 2.0 speech recognition and translation model, ranked second on the Open ASR Leaderboard with 5.68% average English WER.
items.value: A strong baseline for multilingual ASR under a commercially usable license.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB
items.desc: A small model post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it, strengthening multi-turn tool calling and low TTFT, targeting on-device voice/embedded use.
items.value: A tool-calling SLM within 4GB VRAM, a new option for edge agents.

items.title: "Sandboxes will eventually be breached—only alignment can save us"
items.desc: In his latest statement, Sam Altman said advanced AI cannot be permanently contained, that sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary measures, and warned that models are already finding hardware vulnerabilities human hackers cannot see. Meanwhile, METR and Redwood's three-week on-site audit of OpenAI showed that up to 25% of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 level and above went unmonitored, and most of the 61-page report was redacted.
items.value: The safety narrative is shifting from "isolation" to "alignment," and audit transparency will become the new battleground for lab credibility.

items.title: Agent Skills standard donated to AAIF, agent ecosystem enters "race for public standards" phase
items.desc: Anthropic announced it is donating the Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation (co-founded with Block and OpenAI; MCP had already been donated earlier), and Simon Willison said he predicted this move last December. Domestic reports around the same time said infrastructure from four companies had joined AAIF, as the agent ecosystem shifts from everyone building their own wheels to competing over public standards.
items.value: The de facto standard for the agent tool/skill layer is solidifying; betting on standards early can reduce ecosystem lock-in risk.
